card.name: Word-start pieces leading into 'move'-like words
card.fires_on: Short word-start pieces such as '-m', 'unm', 'imm' or 'M' that sit just before a word continuing with 'mov', 'mind' or 'mort'. Common in 'three-movement', 'unmindful', 'immobile' and all-caps warning headers.

modes.label: Pieces before 'movement/mobile'
modes.description: A split-off start of a word that continues as movement, mover or immobile.

modes.label: Un-/im- prefix pieces
modes.description: A negating prefix piece partway through words like unmindful or immobile.

modes.label: All-caps warning headers
modes.description: A single capital letter or piece starting MORTALITY or IMMUNE in boxed warning titles.
